project_info.theme: Luxury beauty close-up with Japanese-inspired crimson kimono styling
project_info.creative_direction: Photoreal editorial transformation anchored by a red silk kimono, matching folding fan, and elegant hair ornament
project_info.color_palette: warm off-white, lacquer crimson, deep red, gold, neutral skin, and muted brown makeup

main_subject.detail: adult woman with calm confident editorial gaze, sleek dark hair, soft face-framing strands, clean winged eyeliner, refined blush, and muted red lacquer lips
main_subject.wardrobe: red silk kimono with subtle tone-on-tone floral or geometric pattern, elegant collar, and optional thin gold trim
main_subject.action: holding a matching red folding fan with gold accents near the face while one hand remains visible near the cheek

composition_elements.framing: 4:5 tight beauty close-up with shallow depth of field
composition_elements.accessories: red-and-gold kanzashi-inspired hairpin, deep red manicure, and one minimal statement ring
composition_elements.background: minimal warm off-white studio with subtle red lacquer ambience and no text or logo

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft diffused beauty key at approximately 5000K with gentle warm rim light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: balanced skin highlights, controlled kimono sheen, fan detail, and refined editorial calm

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 85mm beauty lens, luxury editorial photography
technical_specs.finish: real pores, no plastic skin, natural dynamic range, subtle grain, and crisp silk embroidery

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end editorial beauty portrait of a clearly adult woman with a calm confident gaze, sleek dark hair styled neatly with a red-and-gold kanzashi-inspired hairpin and a few face-framing strands. Use clean winged eyeliner, soft neutral-brown shadow, refined warm blush, muted red lacquer lips, and a deep red manicure. Dress her in a red silk kimono with a subtle tone-on-tone floral or geometric pattern, elegant collar, optional thin gold trim, and no logos. She holds a matching red folding fan with gold accents near the face while one hand remains visible. Use a tight 4:5 beauty close-up, 85mm lens, soft approximately 5000K diffused key with gentle warm rim, shallow depth of field, realistic pores, natural skin texture, and a minimal warm off-white studio with subtle red-lacquer ambience. No text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, modern logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR, harsh shine, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted fan, broken hairpin
